property_summary: Invariant: Only the deployer (owner) can successfully send contract funds via sendMoney(address,uint256); the mutant removing the onlyOwner check allows non-owner callers to transfer funds out, so there exist inputs (a non-owner caller and a nonzero amount) where the mutant changes contract balance while the reference never allows that.
change_summary: Remove the restriction by changing onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove require), so sendMoney can be called by anyone, altering observable behavior.
